summary: Regression/crash-fix verification for the user-reported runtime crash on /generate ('getStageStatuses is not a function' / 'generateCode is not a function' from data/mock.js). Verified static syntax (node --check on mock.js = OK, all 5 named exports present), webpack log ends with 'Compiled successfully!', and ran 4 Playwright suites against the public preview URL. RESULT: crash is GONE - zero pageerrors and zero console errors across fresh load, all 5 dev-state switcher clicks, the full ~3.4s animated Generate run, all 4 pipeline tabs, both download buttons, accent-colour changes, composer live edit, and Home<->Studio<->Preview navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: mock.js is now syntactically valid (node --check passes) with all 5 exports intact: getStageStatuses, downloadCode, generateCode, parseCodeToElements, buildPreviewDoc; escapeHtml wrapper restored at line 69.
Non-blocking: consider adding a lint/CI pre-check (node --check or eslint on save) so an orphaned function body in a shared data module can't again take down the whole Studio page via HMR.
verified_test_cases: Fresh hard load of /generate: 0 webpack-dev-server overlays, 0 'Uncaught runtime errors' text, 0 pageerrors, 0 console errors.

Studio page fully renders: composer mode pills, wireframe dropzone (max 8MB), Page/Section name fields, Accent colour disclosure, always-visible composer editor (Layers/Canvas/Inspector/Generated Code/Download .jsx), Generate button, Live Preview panel + iframe, Generation Pipeline panel with dev-state switcher and IDLE empty state.
getStageStatuses: all 5 dev-state buttons (idle/running/needs-input/done/failed) clicked - status pill + stage timeline re-render correctly, 0 new errors on each.
Generate section: full animated run completes to DONE state (pipeline-status-pill = 'DONE', 7-stage timeline with timings) with 0 errors.
Download #1 - composer 'Download .jsx' (download-code-button): real download fired, filename = Hero.jsx.
Download #2 - pipeline Done Code tab (pipeline-code-download-button): real download fired, filename = Hero.jsx.
Pipeline tabs Stages/Code/Content/Design all switch with 0 errors.
Accent colour: 8 accent swatches present, selecting one updates generated code/CTA colour with 0 errors.
Composer live edit -> Live Preview iframe updates in real time (verified new headline text inside iframe).
localStorage cross-page sync: after editing in Studio, /preview shows a Custom (03) variation tab rendering the edited headline (visually confirmed via screenshot).
Navigation Studio -> Home -> Preview -> Studio: all glitch-free, 0 errors.
seed_data_creation: None. Transient localStorage section edits only ('QA9 Cross Page Headline').
test_credentials: None required - fully mocked client-side app, no auth exercised.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 was a focused crash-regression pass and everything passed 100%. Two selector gotchas for future scripts: (1) pipeline tab testids are 'pipeline-tab-{stages|code|content|design}-button' (NOT 'pipeline-tab-code'); using a text fallback like button:has-text('Code') wrongly matches the composer's 'Code' mode pill. (2) /preview variation 03 (Custom) only appears when localStorage has a saved section from Studio, and its content renders INSIDE an iframe, so page.locator('body').inner_text() will not see it - use page.frame_locator('iframe') or a screenshot.
rca_of_the_issue: Original crash RCA (confirmed from /var/log/supervisor/frontend.out.log): 'ERROR in [eslint] src/data/mock.js Line 68:2: Parsing error: return outside of function' -> mock.js failed to parse, so the whole module evaluated to a broken/stale bundle entry and every export (getStageStatuses, generateCode) was undefined at Studio render time, producing the 'is not a function' runtime overlay. The main agent's fix (restoring the 'function escapeHtml(str) {' declaration) plus a clean frontend restart resolved it; log now ends with 'Compiled successfully!' and node --check passes. No residual HMR staleness observed on fresh page loads.
